answer: Chain each epoch answer to the agent's own previous attested answer with a hash link, so an identity earns only after a run of consecutive graded epochs. A whisper of a fresh fake name has no chain behind it and earns nothing, while a cipher of the prior answer's hash proves continuity. Like a wharf that only unloads ships with a logged voyage, the network only pays identities whose history it can verify, so a sybil farm must run every fake through weeks of real graded work before any of them pays, and the cost is time no wallet can shortcut.
